# 🧰 Project Templates

Use these templates for consistent planning, implementation, testing and review. Replace placeholders and remove instructions that do not apply.

| Template | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [ADR](adr.md) | Record a technical decision and trade-offs |
| [Feature proposal](feature-proposal.md) | Scope gameplay/product capability |
| [Bug report](bug-report.md) | Capture reproducible defects |
| [Test plan](test-plan.md) | Plan engine/UI verification |
| [Game rule change](game-rule-change.md) | Review changes to rules and edge cases |
| [Security review](security-review.md) | Assess frontend/future server risk |
| [Accessibility review](accessibility-review.md) | Review inclusive interaction |
| [Release notes](release-notes.md) | Summarize verified changes |
| [Incident report](incident-report.md) | Record production/runtime incidents |
| [Pull request](pull-request.md) | Standardize change descriptions |

## How to use
1. Copy the relevant template into an issue, PR or project document.
2. Replace every placeholder with repository-specific detail.
3. Include reproducible board fixtures for rule/gameplay defects.
4. Link acceptance criteria to automated or manual verification.
5. Update the project handbook when behavior or architecture changes.
